title: Get Context Response
description: Public response schema for get_context. This schema follows the actual public response shape returned by the workflow: a list of retrieved text blocks from the archive context layer.

success.description: Indicates whether the context retrieval request completed successfully.

result_count.description: Number of retrieved text blocks returned.

results.description: Retrieved archive context blocks. Public examples may truncate long content for readability while preserving the actual response shape.

clean_text.description: Text content returned from the archive context retrieval workflow. Empty strings may occur when the source block is empty or structural.

source.description: Public source label for the archive context source.
